message: ９９点のスウィーツ

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, over here, over here.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why are you here!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even I get cravings for sweets sometimes.」
Saying that, I casually guide Nanaka over to the table.

name: Synn
message: 「Look, Nanaka. I saved one of every kind of sweet for you.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whoa. How thoughtful of you, Synn-kun. Is it gonna rain tomorrow?」

name: Synn
message: 「You're casually pretty harsh too, even though I got some for you as well, Sacchin.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Sorry, sorry~ Maybe it'll be a blizzard instead~」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka?」
Could she have noticed that I mixed in sweets from Peace Tanimura Patisserie?

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, sorry. I'm happy, really. Why, though?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh... as thanks for everything, it's my treat!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaaaat!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Synn-kun. Lying isn't nice~」

name: Synn
message: 「And what basis do you have for calling it a lie!?」
N-No way, did she figure it out?
Admittedly, lined up like this among all these top-notch sweets, the ones from that shop look kind of tacky.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ufufu~ Out of a warrior's mercy, I won't say that there's no way Synn-kun could afford to treat us~」

name: Synn
message: 「...By the way, you're paying for your own share. I don't owe you any thanks.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Gasp.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I get the 'thanks for everything' part, but... are you really okay with the bill?」
I did borrow a little from Eddie, though.

name: Synn
message: 「I'm fine!」
Besides, all I have in front of me is black tea.

name: Sacchin
message: 「When a boy goes out of his way to treat you, it's unrefined to bring up things like that~ Come on, Nana-chan, sit, sit.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's why I told you I'm not treating you.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「On second thought, I'll pay you back later too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Save that talk for later. Come on, dig in already.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Thanks for the fooood!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Thanks for the food.」
Nanaka carefully surveys the sweets lined up across the plate.

name: Sacchin
message: 「So good, so goood. The cheesecake from 'Sans Souci' tastes like pure happiness~ This hearty biscuit crust is something else too~♪ Ukyuu~♪」
Her gaze stops on the sweet from that cake shop.
An eclair stuffed so full of whipped cream it looks ready to burst at any second.
Packed inside the whipped cream are chunks of chocolate.
It looks noticeably sloppy and rough around the edges.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Afaaa... The orange ganache from 'Cafe Rose Blanche' really bursts with sun-ripened orange flavor~♪ Kufuu~♪」
She noticed.
What is Nanaka going to do about the cake from that shop?

name: Sacchin
message: 「The Schwarzwalder from 'Winter der Linden' has an out-of-this-world combo of chocolate and sour cherry compote~♪ Aah, I can't take it, I can't take it~♪」
Still, I get the feeling she wouldn't leave behind a cake that was saved for her.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ufufuu. Aah, this is just the best~ The special bouchee from 'Burgstadt' has a sweeet custard that's totally addictive~♪」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ooh! The framboise chocolat from 'Chocolat l'Or'! It's classic, sure, but that chocolate and raspberry mousse is just~!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You rarely ever get such an exquisite balance of sweetness and tartness~♪」
Nanaka looks at my face, asking what's going on.
I answer with my eyes, telling her it's just what she thinks.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nooow then. Since I already ate half of each~ Which one should I go for next~」

name: Synn
message: 「There's one you haven't even touched, though.」
The eclair was the only thing Sacchin hadn't laid a finger on.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Woman's intuition. Just looking at it screams danger-level dangerous~」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that right?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Haa, it's so hard to choose~ Every single one of them is delicious~ And knowing it's a free treat makes them taste even better~」

name: Synn
message: 「I told you I'm not treating you.」
Giving a small sigh, Nanaka reached for a distinctly plain-looking eclair.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Uh-fu-fuu. Which one should I pick~? So hard to choose, so hard to choose~」
The moment Nanaka took a bite, white cream overflowed from between the pastry layers.
Isn't that way too much cream, no matter how you look at it?
Skillfully keeping the overflowing cream in check with the tip of her tongue, Nanaka continued eating the eclair.
Neither looking like it tasted good nor bad, just completely composed.
The last bit of cream on her lips was licked away with a flick of her tongue, and the eclair disappeared into Nanaka's stomach without a trace.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hey, hey, Nana-chan. How was that eclair~?」
Before we knew it, that manager had appeared right behind Nanaka.
He had his hands clasped together as if in prayer, waiting for Nanaka's verdict.

name: Nanaka
message: 「As I thought, not very good... 25 points.」

name: Synn
message: 「S-So low!」
Hanging his head, the manager's shoulders began to tremble slightly before he suddenly bolted off somewhere.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whoa. That's low~. It did look pretty plain from the outside, though~」
I felt so sorry for the manager.

name: Synn
message: 「Even plain-looking things can taste good, you know.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, sure, maybe~. It just had this sort of spring-water aura, you know~」

name: Synn
message: 「First woman's intuition, and now it's auras?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Then I'll give you half, Synn-kun~」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you sure?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It was bought with your money in the first place, Synn-kun~」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't buy it for you.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, this is just~ so he can do a taste test~, so don't get mad, okay~?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What are you talking about!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Even though you totally know~. Here you go, Synn-kun.」
Displaying the hyper-specific dexterity she occasionally showed, Sacchin split the eclair neatly in half and handed a piece to me.

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks for the food...」
I braced myself to some extent and took a bite, and yet.

name: Sacchin
message: 「...I see~」

name: Synn
message: 「Is this really that bad? It's plenty sweet.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is that your only standard for taste?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, it'd be a problem if it were salty~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's out of the question.」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides... how should I put it... it has a nostalgic kind of taste.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「More like the kind of thing I wouldn't pay money to eat~」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you two have some kind of grudge against this place? It's just a normal sweet dessert.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You'd say 'Delicious!' even to a sugar cube, wouldn't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Urk.」
Nanaka chuckled a little.

name: Nanaka
message: 「You really haven't changed at all. Even when I fed you delicious things, it was always 'sweet and delicious' with you.」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry about that!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A long time ago. You had the exact same reaction when you ate an eclair that looked just like this one.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... I ate something just like this?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah. An eclair with chocolate chips mixed into lots of fresh cream.」

name: Synn
message: 「We never had sweets served at my house, though...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It was when you came over to my place to hang out, a few times. Though it'd be an insult to compare the taste to this one, since that was so delicious.」
I remember.
The pastries Nanaka's aunt used to serve us.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Remember now?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Yeah, I remember.」
Nanaka and I, sitting side by side, stuffing our cheeks with eclairs.
Nanaka looked truly happy...

name: Synn
message: 「They were... really delicious.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「'Sweet and delicious,' right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... that's what I said.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You've always had a pretty poor vocabulary when it comes to describing food, haven't you? Since way back when. You just eat anything and everything like it's delicious.」

name: Synn
message: 「But... that cake really was... delicious.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see. It really was delicious, huh? I'm glad.」
I remember.
The rich, sweet, yet somehow refreshing taste of all that whipped cream.
The slightly bitter chocolate chips went together with the whipped cream exquisitely.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Remembering it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」
Honestly, I feel bad for the manager, but this eclair doesn't even compare.

name: Nanaka
message: 「To me, that was a 99-point sweet.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh. So that's the 99-point sweet you were talking about before~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah. Since it's a memory, I'm sure it tastes even better than it really did, though.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whoa. It was good enough to make even you say that, Nana-chan~ I wish I could've tried it~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Why did it disappear?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The shop got run out of business.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whaaaaaaaaat!!」
Still, if that's the case.

name: Synn
message: 「...Then why does this eclair feel somehow nostalgic?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's--」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「I believe it is because my father was the one who made that eclair.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「W-Who are you all of a sudden!?」
Having returned before we knew it, the manager looked somehow happy.
Why, though, when he had looked so down just a moment ago?
Without any sign of surprise, Nanaka picked up where he left off.

name: Nanaka
message: 「The previous owner of 'Peace Tanimura Patisserie'--this guy's dad--was, out of everyone I know--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The greatest patissier there was.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「'Peace Tanimura Patisserie' was the shop of my first love.」

name: Synn
message: 「First love?」
Sacchin, who had been quietly munching away on her cake, chimed in.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Were you head over heels for that distinguished silver fox of an old man?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, he was completely bald, and I wasn't in love with the old man.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ahh, not that kind of first love, huh. Nom nom.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「My first love doesn't matter! A-Anyway.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It looked plain and unfashionable like this eclair, but the taste was amazing. Every time I ate it, I felt so happy.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Could it be that your obsession with sweets is.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grandpa's sweets were where it all started.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan's 99-pointer, huh--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「He was a cranky guy, you know. Still, he was kind to me...」
Nanaka's eyes grew distant.

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「That was... because you genuinely loved sweets.」
The manager, who was sitting with us, gently interjected.
Even though she had seemed to hate him so much, Nanaka didn't say a word about him joining us at the table.

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Thinking about it now, to my father... you were the best person to savor his sweets with the most honest and sensitive palate... Probably far more than me.」
Still, why does this guy look so happy after getting such a low score?

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whoa. Nana-chan's quite the older-man killer, isn't she--」

name: Synn
message: 「That's slightly off from how you're supposed to use that phrase, isn't it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grandpa Tanimura used to order soba from our place a lot.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「When I went to deliver it, he'd sometimes let me eat sweets for free, and he even let me into the kitchen...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The way his hands moved when making sweets was like magic. I always wondered how he could do it all so fast.」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Whenever he made a new creation, he always had you try it first.」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「He trusted your palate more than mine.」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「My father kept a secret recipe book. While he was alive, he never showed it to me once...」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Yet he let you look at it plenty of times. Honestly, I was envious... That's why I did what I did...」
So he'd passed away.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Huh? Earlier, didn't you say the shop got ruined, Nana-chan?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, now that you mention it.」
Even though the difference in taste was brutally obvious, the shop had still been passed down.

name: Sacchin
message: 「I get it! That means it's basically the same as being ruined.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... Wait, I think you should sugarcoat your words a little more.」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「...I'm the one who ruined it.」
The manager hung his head.

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Grandpa Tanimura had a bit of a complex.」

name: Synn
message: 「A complex?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Since he pretty much taught himself how to make sweets, he'd obviously never trained in their country of origin.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So it seems he was convinced that compared to authentic sweets, his own were just cheap imitations...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even though that wasn't true at all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's why he dreamed of his successor training abroad and learning to make authentic sweets, so they wouldn't end up making imitations...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「He told me so many times that if he were twenty years younger, he'd go train there himself. Over and over again...」
Nanaka gave a small smile, perhaps remembering her conversations with Grandpa Tanimura.

name: Nanaka
message: 「And then, he said that once his son came back from training and took over the shop, he really wanted me to taste the real thing.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It was about a week before he passed away, I think... Grandpa ordered some soba, so I went to deliver it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The shop had been closed for about a month, so I'd been worried... but he seemed really lively that day.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「For some reason, he had me eat one of every single kind of sweet in the shop.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「They were just as delicious as always, so I was happy and relieved. I figured the shop would reopen soon too.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And then he told me that the sweets made by his son, who'd be finishing his training and coming home soon, would be even more delicious than these...」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait... was that the last time?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah. Grandpa passed away shortly after that. His wife had died a long time ago, so everyone in the shopping district pitched in to hold his funeral...」

name: Synn
message: 「...I remember that. I attended too... Nanaka was bawling her eyes out.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Childhood friends remember the most unnecessary things, it's such a pain.」

name: Synn
message: 「Right back at you.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「And so the shop went under... Huh? Wasn't it driven under instead--?」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「That's right... It was driven under. By me.」
The manager gave a weak smile.

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Back then, I hated the tacky sweets my father made... I thought they weren't even fit to serve to customers... So...」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「I changed every kind of sweet we served at the shop. So not a single trace of my father would remain, I even remodeled it from its typical neighborhood cake-shop look.」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Finding an unrefined name like 'Peace Tanimura Patisserie' repulsive even to look at, I renamed it 'Alexandrine'」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Even the recipes that were the culmination of my father's life as a pastry chef... I threw them all away.」

name: Synn
message: 「'Alexandrine'!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What's with the sudden outburst.」

name: Synn
message: 「Uncle Amakawa once told me, 'Rather than buy cake from that place, you'd be better off licking a sugar cube'! It's that cake shop!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... Excuse me.」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「...It's the truth, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「What's wrong--?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh no! I have to be there for the final delivery of supplies!」

name: Synn
message: 「Aren't you on break right now?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehh. And we were just getting to the good part--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I am on break, but I have to oversee this. So, sorry! Go ahead and eat the leftover sweets.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yay, leave it to me--!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, wait a second, Nanaka...」
She left.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Massive sweet reinforcements. Yay--」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「What is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka was the very first one to rush over when that restaurant first opened, wasn't she?」
If it was a promise she made to her grandfather, there's no doubt about it.

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「She did come. And... I cursed her out.」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be... Nanaka gave a merciless review?」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「...It was 15 points.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa...」
That's even worse than now!

name: Sacchin
message: 「At that point, that's not even at the level of food anymore~」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「I berated her, calling her a worthless fool who doesn't understand authentic flavor, and threw her out of the shop...」

name: Synn
message: 「But, um... if you don't mind me saying so. Weren't other people's reactions bad too?」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Yeah... though nobody else said it quite that bluntly.」

name: Synn
message: 「You didn't... throw everyone out, did you?」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「...Maybe she was the very one I wanted praise from... The one who knew my father's cooking best.」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Maybe that's precisely why she was the one person I couldn't forgive... Whatever the reason, I was a fool.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I see~ So that's how the bad reputation spread and it ended up like that~」

name: Synn
message: 「Still... Nanaka was the one who kept coming back, wasn't she?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan does have a really loyal side to her, after all~」

name: Synn
message: 「...So that's why she knew.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah. I always thought it was weird. Like, why would she go back over and over to a place she gave a low score to~? Totally unlike her~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「On top of that, he'd yell at Nana-chan and kick her out~ Kicking out a customer~」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「The last time she came by... you were there too, weren't you?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I was~ It was intense~」

name: Synn
message: 「Intense?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You see, when Nana-chan muttered 'twelve points'--」

name: Synn
message: 「Twelve points?!」
What kind of sweets were they?!

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「I lost my temper too... and yelled at her. Told her I'd never sell to her again.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「And then Nana-chan finally snapped too. She yelled, 'Like I'd ever eat your stuff again, you prodigal son!' and they had a huge fight. That was half a year ago~」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... it might be rude to ask this, but at that point, weren't they-the Sweets Club-your only repeat customers?」
The manager gave a small nod. No wonder the place was going out of business.

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「After that... I only got about one customer a month... Belatedly, I finally began to realize my mistake.」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「When I tried the sweets from other shops... mine didn't even compare... I couldn't even tell what to fix or how to make them decent...」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「That's how I finally understood that she had been right all along.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan never compromises when it comes to sweets~」

name: Synn
message: 「But... Nanaka stopped coming to the shop.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「She tried not to even walk past the storefront. Whenever she did, she'd turn her face away~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I thought she just hated it that much, but I was wrong, huh.」
She must have had fond memories of that shop, which is why she couldn't bear to look at it.

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「...I remembered how happily she used to eat my father's sweets.」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「So I got the idea to try making my father's sweets myself. I even thought his unsophisticated sweets would be easy to make.」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「I had thrown away all his recipes, so I recreated them from my memories of helping him out...」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「However, the sweets I made that way couldn't hold a candle to what my father made...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I bet~ His got ninety-nine points, after all~」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「My father was the real deal. A truly great patissier. The person I should have learned from was right beside me the whole time...」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「I didn't notice. I didn't even try to notice. No, maybe I did realize it.」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Maybe that's why... I threw away my father's recipes. Out of petty, pathetic jealousy...」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be that from that time until now, you've been trying to recreate your father's sweets the whole time? And even put the old sign back up?」
The manager gave a small nod.

name: Synn
message: 「It was 12 points, wasn't it?」
The manager gave another small nod.

name: Synn
message: 「Then your score went up by a whole 13 points in just half a year! That's not something you can pull off so easily!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, when a score is that low, there's nowhere to go but up~」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you trying to cheer him up, Sacchin?」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「...Right now, just having her evaluate it like that is enough to satisfy me...」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「I still can't hold a candle to my father, but at least it's become something that can be called sweets...」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「With this, I can keep pushing forward until the day our shop's reputation grows and she comes back to visit us again.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「At this rate, who knows when that day'll ever come!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka?!」
Nanaka was drenched in sweat. It looked like she had just run a long distance.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, you're sweating so much~. Here, a handkerchief~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huff, huff... thanks.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, water.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, thank you.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Pwahhh! Kuuu, that hits the spot!」
Still panting painfully, Nanaka nevertheless.
She pulled several notebooks out of the bag she was carrying and handed them to the manager.

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「...Th-This is?! All ten volumes are here! How did you get these?!」
They were old, worn-out notebooks.

name: Nanaka
message: 「They're your grandpa's recipe books.」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「But I was sure... I had disposed of all of them...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I've been waking up early to help out at my family's shop ever since I was a kid. That's how I found them at the garbage dump before the trash truck came.」
The manager opened one of the notebooks.
Neat handwriting in ink and pencil, along with sketches of sweets, filled the pages from edge to edge.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still... I couldn't bring myself to hand them over for the longest time...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even if I kept them, I couldn't make any of it... but I figured that was still better than giving them to you, when you'd throw them away without even knowing their worth.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「But I feel like it's okay to give it to you now.」
I see... So the reason she suddenly got up from her seat was to go all the way home to fetch this.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I think your grandfather would be happier that way, too.」
The manager hugged the notebook tight and started crying.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Let me eat 'Peace Tanimura Patisserie's' unsophisticated-looking yet exquisite sweets again, okay?」
The manager nodded over and over again.
He looked like he was trying to say something, but the words wouldn't come out.

name: Nanaka
message: 「You don't need any words. Taste speaks louder than words, after all.」
